Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCL Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the NCL Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) recruitment is 06 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) post in Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Executive Programme and completed the Executive Development Programme from ICSI to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 22,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this NCL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NCL Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) post?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a merit list prepared from the aggregate passing percentage of the Executive Programme of ICSI, followed by document scrutiny.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the NCL located?
faq.answer: Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL) is located in Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the job type for this Executive Programme Exam Passed Trainee (Company Secretary) position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of NCL, which is www.nclcil.in.
